L2·N4902unmasked layer
Fires on the continuation token inside a fixed, highly predictable multi-token English collocation or word — most strongly the space preceding "100%" in "would/not 100% …", plus completions like "Zeh-ut", "Z-ech.", "up-to-date", "well on our way" — i.e. a mid-idiom/mid-word slot rather than a semantic category (it is strongly suppressed by analogous word-completion fragments in Dutch/German and rare names).
